name: batched_gemm
summary: C[b] = A[b] B[b] for b < BATCH with A BATCH x M x K, B BATCH x K x N, C BATCH x M x N, all f32 row-major
provenance: authored for OpenAccel Lab (Apache-2.0); strided-batched SGEMM NN semantics with alpha=1, beta=0

C.why: each C[b][i][j] is a length-K dot product; in any summation order, fused or not, |err| <= gamma(K)*sum_k |A[b][i][k] B[b][k][j]| (Higham Thm 3.1/3.5); reference.py passes that sum as scale. WolframLanguageEvaluator: g[n_]:=n 2^-24/(1-n 2^-24); N[g[36],6] -> 2.14577*10^-6, N[g[11],6] -> 6.55652*10^-7
